notes.title: FARIA: Starfall is Released!
notes.notes:
Fraught with equal amounts of excitement and terror, it is quite surreal to view myself typing the headline above. Much like the characters within my tale, it has been a long and arduous road to arrive at where I am, releasing this game on Steam.

For those who give this game their time of day and better yet, those who are willing to purchase this product of my unceasing love for the medium, I cannot thank you enough. If this game is for but one moment able to raise a smile on a player's face, then it will have all been worth it.

Allow me to recite once more, the premise of this inspiring tale:

"Prepare to embark on the most wondrous of adventures across a fantastical kingdom that is now being ravaged by an increasingly lethal climate. To subvert the soggy future that currently confronts Faria and The World, you will follow the lives and escapades of a wide cast of characters as they make battle with a variety of threats and the steady escalation of odds, doing everything they can to restore the peace and the stability of their homeland.

With its tightly-paced, poignantly-written narrative, Starfall will surprise, delight and destroy you along your journey, culminating in an experience that is by all means unforgettable!"

Love,
Faria.

notes.title: Starfall's Trading Cards and Badges!
notes.notes:
6 badges, 7 cards, 7 backgrounds and 10 emoticons await your eager collection for FARIA: Starfall. They are all composed of either high-fidelity artwork or "aww"-promoting cute pixel art. I hope that sounds as lovely to you as it does for I.

There is a problem, however.

Steam does not allow their launch until sales of the game have passed a certain "threshold". Whatever that threshold may be, I haven't a clue! But rest assured that the moment I receive permission to launch them, they will indeed go live. As a fan of my own game, I myself am truly excited to have these wonderful things set free but until then, there's nothing I can do but wait.

I sincerely apologise for this delay! >.< ːglobglobː
